newsitem.title: JAPAN: Daiei, Daiei OMC shares up on president's comments.
newsitem.headline: Daiei, Daiei OMC shares up on president's comments.

text.p: Daiei Inc and a subsidiary, Daiei OMC Inc, rose in Monday morning trade on media reports that Daiei president Isao Nakauchi had said there were no factors to hurt prices of the shares, brokers said.
As of 0127 GMT, Daiei, a supermarket operator, was up 27 yen or 5.07 percent at 560, the second largest percentage gainer on the first section of the Tokyo bourse.
It was also the third most actively traded issue with 2.748 million shares changing hands.
Credit sales firm Daiei OMC rose five yen to 221.
A Daiei spokeswoman confirmed Nakauchi's comments, which were reported by the financial daily, Nihon Keizai Shimbun.

"Our management and business are seen on the road to recovery from the latter half of the 1997/98 business year ending in February," Nakauchi was quoted as saying. "There are no factors to invite selling of our shares."
"As far as Daiei OMC is concerned, the bad loan problem is in the process of being cleared up and there is no change in the fact that Daiei will continue to provide the firm with support," he said.
